description.en: Open, close, stop and go to a position; the status is read after each command and every 10 s. Requests: 9A, ID, channel mask, command, data, XOR. The motor answers queries only, never control commands.
description.zh-Hant: 開、關、停、到指定位置；每個指令之後和每 10 秒查一次狀態。請求：9A、ID、通道遮罩、指令、資料、XOR。馬達只回答查詢，控制指令不回覆。

description.en: Motor ID as one HEX byte: IDs 1–99 are 01–63 (00 = all motors).
description.zh-Hant: 馬達 ID，一個 HEX 位元組：ID 1–99 寫成 01–63（00 是群控）。

description.en: Channel mask, low byte first: channel 1 = 01 00, channel 8 = 80 00, channel 9 = 00 01.
description.zh-Hant: 通道遮罩，低位元組在前：第 1 通道＝01 00、第 8 通道＝80 00、第 9 通道＝00 01。

notes.en: Factory speed is 2400 baud; on a 9600 bus with one A-OK motor connected, send 9A 00 00 00 DA 03 D9 once to switch it to 9600. Its position runs the other way (0 = open), so the template maps it (ranges.position = 100 → 0); check the direction on site. Only the status query is answered: the position follows from polling. Some AM35 answer queries meant for other motors: the reply pattern checks the ID and channel.
notes.zh-Hant: 出廠鮑率是 2400；要接在 9600 的匯流排上時，只接這一台 A-OK 送一次 9A 00 00 00 DA 03 D9 改成 9600。它的位置方向相反（0＝開），範本已經換算（ranges.position＝100 → 0），到現場請確認方向。只有查詢會回覆，位置靠輪詢。部分 AM35 會回答發給別台的查詢，所以回覆樣式會比對 ID 和通道。
